message: Control for yolov8_v10_robot_frozen: identical recipe (same freeze=21, same dataset/sam3_v6_pseudo_split 102/26 video-frame split, same hyperparameters, same loco_full_v3 starting checkpoint) but WITHOUT adding the iw_hub class -- plain 5-class fine-tune. Purpose: isolate whether adding a new class caused the LOCO-val forgetting seen in yolov8_v10_robot_frozen, or whether it was already caused by fine-tuning the shared Detect head on this small (102 img), class-imbalanced video-frame set alone (as previously seen with a full, unfrozen fine-tune in yolov8_v4). Result: both this control (AP_50 OVERALL 0.117) and yolov8_v10_robot_frozen (AP_50 OVERALL 0.104) degrade almost identically from the baseline (0.257) -- the new class is NOT the cause; the small/skewed video-frame set is.
